name: half knee bends (male)
description: A steady cardio step: one knee comes up to about hip height while the standing leg gives a little bend, then the legs swap.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms bent in front of your chest.
Lift one knee up to about hip height while the standing knee bends slightly.
Put the foot back down and lift the other knee the same way.
Keep alternating at a steady pace, chest up and core braced.
